timeline.text: A kid watching an explainer film could sit through long stretches where nothing moved.
The old timeline padded shots to fit a slow camera move, even when the sentence didn't need it.
Like a train waiting at a station just because the next track isn't ready yet.
Now the engine refuses a shot that sits still too long; every beat must change something.
A shot can't sit still past 8 seconds, and total silence can't pass 15 percent.
